components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action control, blue on light surfaces and white on dark heroes.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 11px 22px; border: none; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--c-accent, #1A77E3); color: #fff; font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px -6px rgba(26, 119, 227, 0.10); transition: opacity 0.18s, transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-accent, #1A77E3); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action that keeps the page quiet until the user hovers or focuses.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 11px 22px; border: 1px solid var(--c-line, #E3E6ED); border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--c-fg, #111827); font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; transition: background 0.18s, border-color 0.18s, transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--c-600, #EEF1FA); border-color: var(--c-dim, #47494E); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-accent, #1A77E3); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Sticky white brand shell with compact decision-oriented labels.
components.html: RVAPHomeSessions
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 58px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid var(--c-line, #E3E6ED); border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(160%); font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-nav-brand { margin-right: auto; color: var(--c-heading, #032254); font-family: var(--font-display, Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 6px 11px; border-radius: 7px; color: var(--c-dim, #47494E); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link-active { color: var(--c-fg, #111827); background: var(--c-600, #EEF1FA); } .ds-nav-icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--c-dim, #47494E); } .ds-nav-icon:hover { background: var(--c-600, #EEF1FA); color: var(--c-fg, #111827); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible, .ds-nav-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-accent, #1A77E3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-session-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: grid; gap: 14px; padding: 24px 22px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--c-line, #E3E6ED); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--c-800, #FFFFFF); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(3, 34, 84, 0.08), 0 4px 12px rgba(3, 34, 84, 0.06); color: var(--c-fg, #111827); transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 0.25s; } .ds-session-card::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0 0 auto 0; height: 3px; background: #504092; } .ds-session-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px -12px rgba(3, 34, 84, 0.28), 0 2px 6px rgba(3, 34, 84, 0.08); } .ds-session-chip { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 7px; background: #504092; color: #fff; font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-weight: 600; } .ds-session-card h3 { margin: 0; color: var(--c-heading, #032254); font-family: var(--font-display, Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-session-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--c-dim, #47494E); font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-session-card strong { color: var(--c-faint, #6B7280); font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
The AI Governance Platform visual system should feel like a calm executive briefing room for decisions that need evidence, owners, and safe handoff. It is calm, executive, evidence-first, facilitator-friendly, and Microsoft-aligned: a structured workspace where cross-functional leaders can scan, trust, and act without mistaking templates for proof.

The system uses RVAP light surfaces, Deep Navy authority, RVAP Blue action, and compact mono labels to create the rhythm of a professional governance packet. It avoids playful consumer SaaS, dark cyber dashboards, decorative gradients that dilute the evidence hierarchy, and fabricated proof signals.
keyCharacteristics: Light, breathable documentation canvas with restrained institutional color.
Strong navy-to-blue hero moments reserved for orientation and confidence.
Cards, chips, and session rails that clarify ownership, phase, evidence, and sequence.
Mono labels used as coordinates, not as decoration.
Motion and depth kept subtle so content remains the product.

rules.name: The Evidence First Rule
rules.body: Color must clarify status, phase, ownership, or action; it must not imply proof that the customer has not provided.

rules.name: The Blue Scarcity Rule
rules.body: RVAP Blue is strongest when it is rare. Use it for decisive affordances and evidence links, not for washing every module.

rules.name: The Semantic Exception Rule
rules.body: Green, caution gold, red, purple, teal, and slate are allowed when they encode real status, phase, or assurance meaning.

rules.name: The Briefing Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Every screen should make the next decision obvious through one strong headline, short explanatory prose, and compact metadata.

rules.name: The Mono Coordinates Rule
rules.body: Mono type labels navigation, state, and evidence coordinates; do not use it for body paragraphs or decorative texture.

rules.name: The Scannable Handoff Rule
rules.body: Dense governance material must be chunked into cards, steps, chips, and facts before it becomes a wall of prose.

rules.name: The Tonal Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Prefer surface color, border, and accent bars first; add shadow only when interaction or modal priority needs it.

rules.name: The No Novel Silhouette Rule
rules.body: New components should use the existing 7/12/18px radius scale and thin border language unless a user explicitly asks for a new visual world.

dos: Do preserve the RVAP light canvas, Deep Navy authority, and RVAP Blue action hierarchy.
Do use cards, chips, and fact rows to make owners, evidence, session phase, and next decisions scannable.
Do keep focus rings visible and use the existing 2px RVAP Blue outline treatment.
Do use semantic accent colors when they encode real phase, status, risk, or assurance meaning.
Do keep long-form documentation readable with narrow measures, plain language, and generous section rhythm.
donts: Don't use dark cyber dashboard styling, neon security tropes, or decorative gradients that compete with evidence hierarchy.
Don't use color, badges, charts, or testimonials to imply customer proof that the product does not have.
Don't turn mono labels into body copy or decorative noise.
Don't introduce new corner-radius scales, heavy shadows, or ornamental component silhouettes without an explicit redesign request.
Don't collapse status and phase colors into RVAP Blue when the distinction carries meaning.
